filing_office: Missouri Secretary of State, Corporations Division
filing_fee_notes: Online base fee; paper filing costs 105. Electronic payments incur an additional convenience fee.
registered_agent_rules: A Missouri resident or authorized corporation must maintain the registered office at its business office. A physical street address is required; a P.O. box alone is insufficient.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Employment Security
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and keep a registered agent. Missouri LLCs do not file annual reports with the Secretary of State.
common_mistake: Do not file your operating agreement with the Secretary of State.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Annual report name, due date and filing URL are null because no LLC annual report is required. Processing time, expedite options, publication requirements and franchise or privilege tax treatment were not confirmed in the permitted sources.
